blocks.text: DONALD HEATHFIELD? TRACEY FOLEY? YOU ARE UNDER ARREST.
CANADIAN BIRTH CERTIFICATES. DONALD HEATHFIELD, TRACEY FOLEY...
THE REAL ONES DIED AS BABIES, IN CANADA, YEARS AGO. THEY TOOK THEIR NAMES.
BORN IN TORONTO. THEY THINK THEY'RE CANADIAN. THEY DON'T EVEN SPEAK RUSSIAN.
TUOMI, AT LEAST, KEPT HIS OWN NAME.
